# Coverage depth data
## Mean depth
```{r, eval=TRUE}
data <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "mosdepth_data", "realized.cov.all"), sep=" ", header=TRUE)
head(data)

data$WolRatio <- 2*data$covW/(data$covA) 

data[ data$ID%in%c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "IT_Tre_Om300", "Iso-FR-Par006" , "Col-FR-Ren000"), ]

```

## Sequence coverage at each position

The variation of coverage for the different individual was estimated with *samtools* using the following command:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
for ii in ../data/genomic_data/bam_data/*.dedup.bam
do

samtools view -F 0x900 -O BAM $ii.dedup.bam wSuz_1 wSuz_2 wSuz_3 wSuz_4 |samtools depth -a - | gzip > $ii.wSuz.primary.depth.gz
samtools view -F 0x100 -O BAM $ii.dedup.bam wSuz_1 wSuz_2 wSuz_3 wSuz_4 |samtools depth -a - | gzip > $ii.wSuz.primary_supp.depth.gz
samtools view -bh -F 0x900 -O BAM $ii.dedup.bam wSuz_1 wSuz_2 wSuz_3 wSuz_4 > $ii.dedup.primary.bam
samtools view -bh -F 0x100 -O BAM $ii.dedup.bam wSuz_1 wSuz_2 wSuz_3 wSuz_4 > $ii.dedup.primary_supp.bam
done
```

# Normalized coverage depth at cif genes
## Coverage per wSuz position
```{r, eval=TRUE}
gene.position <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_genes_BLAST_hits.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

## Name of the four contigs
contig <- c("wSuz_1", "wSuz_2", "wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")

#for(s in c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006")){
s="Col-FR-Bal001"
tmp=read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "bam_data" , paste0(s, ".wSuz.primary.depth.gz"))), header=FALSE)
colnames(tmp) <- c("contig", "position", "Col-FR-Bal001")
tmp <- tmp[tmp$contig %in% contig, ]

tmp <- tmp |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = sapply(seq_len(nrow(tmp)), function(i) {
      
      hit <- gene.position$gene[
        gene.position$contig == tmp$contig[i] &
        tmp$position[i] >= gene.position$start &
        tmp$position[i] <= gene.position$end
      ]
      
      if (length(hit) > 0) {
        hit
      } else {
        NA
      }
    })
  )|>
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_relative_position = sapply(seq_len(nrow(tmp)), function(i) {
      
      start <- gene.position$start[
        gene.position$contig == tmp$contig[i] &
        tmp$position[i] >= gene.position$start &
        tmp$position[i] <= gene.position$end
      ]
      
      
      if (length(start) > 0) {
        if(gene.position$strand[gene.position$start==start]=="+"){
          tmp$position[i]-start+1
        }else{
          end <- gene.position$end[
        gene.position$contig == tmp$contig[i] &
        tmp$position[i] >= gene.position$start &
        tmp$position[i] <= gene.position$end
      ]
          end-tmp$position[i]+1
        }
        
      } else {
        NA
      }
    })
  )

## Correct relative position for the 5' part of TypeII_cifA
tmp <- tmp|>
  dplyr::mutate(gene_relative_position=dplyr::if_else(grepl("TypeII_cifA", gene)&position>=780652, gene_relative_position+322, gene_relative_position))

## Add the type of genes
tmp <- tmp|>
  dplyr::left_join(y=gene.position[, c("gene", "type")], by="gene") |>
  dplyr::relocate('Col-FR-Bal001', .after = dplyr::last_col())

## Add the coverage of the other strains
for(s in c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006")){
  #s="Col-FR-Ren000"
  tmp2=read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "bam_data" , paste0(s, ".wSuz.primary.depth.gz"))), header=FALSE)
 tmp <- tmp|>
  dplyr::mutate("{s}":=tmp2$V3)
 
  }

## Check the length of each gene copy
tmp|>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene))|>
  dplyr::group_by(gene)|>
  dplyr::summarise(length=max(gene_relative_position))

## Compute the length of each gene
gene_length <- tmp |>
  dplyr::mutate(gene=gsub("_3|_2|_1","", gene))|>
  dplyr::group_by(gene) |>
  dplyr::summarise(length=max(gene_relative_position))

write.table(tmp, file=gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "coverage.txt.gz")),
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE)
```


## Plot for Fig. 4D
### Load coverage data
```{r, eval=TRUE}

tmp <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "coverage.txt.gz")),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"))

# For Svitlana computer
#tmp <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", #"coverage.txt")),
#  header = TRUE,
#  sep = "\t"))

## Convert to long format
tmp <- tmp |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
  cols = Col.FR.Bal001:last_col(),
  names_to = c("strain"),
  values_to = "coverage"
  )

## Mean coverage per strain and per contig
contig_coverage <- tmp |>
  dplyr::group_by(strain, contig)|>
  dplyr::summarise(
    contig_length = sum(!is.na(coverage)),
    mean_contig_coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE))|>
   dplyr::mutate(strain_contig=paste(strain, contig, sep="_"))

```

### Coverage per gene for wSuz
```{r, eval=TRUE}

## Compute the normalized coverage per position
tmp <- tmp|>
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("sr3", gene)&!is.na(gene)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(gene=gsub("_3|_2|_1","", gene))|>
  dplyr::mutate(strain_contig=paste(strain, contig, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::left_join(contig_coverage[,c("strain_contig", "mean_contig_coverage")], by ="strain_contig")|>
  dplyr::mutate(normalized_coverage=coverage/mean_contig_coverage)|>
  dplyr::mutate(gene = as.factor(gene))|>
  dplyr::mutate(gene = forcats::fct_relevel(gene, "wsp", after = 1))

gene_position_coverage <- tmp |>
  dplyr::group_by(strain, gene, gene_relative_position) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(coverage)),
    sum_position_coverage=sum(normalized_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gene_coverage <- gene_position_coverage |>
  dplyr::group_by(strain, gene) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_position= dplyr::n(),
    mean_normalized_coverage = mean(sum_position_coverage),
    sd_normalized_coverage  = sd(sum_position_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    #se = sd_normalized_coverage / sqrt(n_position),
    #t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n_position - 1),
    #ci_lower = mean_normalized_coverage - t_critical * se,
    #ci_upper = mean_normalized_coverage + t_critical * se,
    .groups = "drop")|>
  dplyr::mutate(strain = as.factor(strain))

## Rename strains
gene_coverage <- gene_coverage |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    strain = dplyr::recode(
      strain,
      "Col.FR.Bal001"  = "Bal",
      "Col.FR.Ren000"  = "Rennes",
      "Col.IT.Tre000"  = "Trento",
      "Iso.FR.Par006"  = "Par6",
    )
  )

#Add type of the gene to the database
gene_coverage <- gene_coverage |> dplyr::mutate(gene_type = dplyr::case_when(gene %in% c("wsp", "FtsZ") ~ "One-copy gene", grepl("TypeII", gene) ~ "cif Type II", grepl("TypeI", gene) ~ "cif Type I", TRUE ~ NA_character_))

gene_coverage <- gene_coverage |> dplyr::mutate(gene_type = dplyr::case_when(gene %in% c("wsp", "FtsZ") ~ "One-copy gene", grepl("TypeII", gene) ~ "cif Type II", grepl("TypeI", gene) ~ "cif Type I"), gene_type = factor(gene_type, levels = c("One-copy gene", "cif Type I", "cif Type II")))

## Plot
gene_coverage|>
  dplyr::filter(strain!="US.CA_wRI_Dsim2"&strain!="ZB_wRI_Dsim1")|>
  ggplot(aes(x = gene, y = mean_normalized_coverage, fill=gene_type)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_normalized_coverage-sd_normalized_coverage, ymax = mean_normalized_coverage+sd_normalized_coverage),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("One-copy gene" = "#7B6BA8", "cif Type I" = "#E83E8C", "cif Type II" = "#E89C50"), labels = c("One-copy gene" = "One-copy gene", "cif Type I" = expression(italic("cif")~"Type I"), "cif Type II" = expression(italic("cif")~"Type II")), name = NULL) +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  #theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Gene",
    y = "Mean normalized gene coverage",
    #title = "Mean coverage"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("FtsZ" = "ftsZ", "wsp" = "wsp", "TypeI_cifA" = "cifA", "TypeI_cifB" = "cifB", "TypeII_cifA" = "cifA", "TypeII_cifB" = "cifB")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic", colour = "black", margin = margin(t = 5)), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black", margin = margin(t = 5)), strip.text = element_text(size =17, colour = "black"), legend.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"), legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.93, 0.85),legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5), plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 20)) +
  facet_wrap(~strain)

ggsave(file.path(here::here(), "plots", "Fig.4D_Normalized_coverage.pdf"), width = 30, height = 15, units = "cm")

```

# Plot per consecutive windows of 1 kb for all strains (not included in the paper)
```{r wSuz coverage}
library(zoo)
det.sample <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "ids.txt"), sep=" ", header=FALSE)

gene.position <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_genes_BLAST_hits.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

head(det.sample)
names(det.sample)="Sample ID"


#col.sample=rep(3,nrow(det.sample))
#col.sample[which(grepl("Om300",det.sample$`Sample ID`) | grepl("Iso-",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=4
#col.sample[which(grepl("Col-",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=5
#col.sample[which(grepl("sub",det.sample$`Sample ID`) | grepl("CN-Kun",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=8
#col.sample[which(grepl("sim",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=7
#names(col.sample)=det.sample$`Sample ID`


contig <- c("wSuz_1", "wSuz_2", "wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")

#for(s in c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006")){
  s="Col-FR-Bal001"
  tmp=read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "bam_data" , paste0(s, ".wSuz.primary.depth.gz"))), header=FALSE)
  #tmp=read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "bam_data" , paste0(s, ".dedup.bam.wSuz.depth.gz"))), header=FALSE)
  colnames(tmp) <- c("contig", "position", "coverage")
  tmp <- tmp[tmp$contig %in% contig, ]

  
  # Calculate 1 kb rolling coverage separately for each contig
  tmp$coverage_1kb <- NA_real_
  
  for (ctg in contig) {
    
    idx <- tmp$contig == ctg
    
    tmp$coverage_1kb[idx] <- zoo::rollmean(
      tmp$coverage[idx],
      k = 1000,
      fill = NA,
      align = "center"
    )
  }

# Length of wSuz_1
wSuz_1_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"])

# Length of wSuz_2
wSuz_2_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"])
   
# Length of wSuz_3
wSuz_3_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"])


gene.position$position <- (gene.position$start + gene.position$end)/2
gene.position$plot_position <- gene.position$position
gene.position$label_position <- gene.position$position

## Wsuz_1 Type I
gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==691] <-  gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==691]  + 100000
gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==823038] <-  gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==823038]  - 100000
## Wsuz_2 Type I
gene.position$plot_position[gene.position$start==3609] <-  wSuz_1_length + gene.position$plot_position[gene.position$start==3609]
gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==3609] <-  wSuz_1_length + gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==3609]  + 100000

## Wsuz_1 Type II

gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==781710] <-  gene.position$label_position[gene.position$start==781710]  - 150000

# Add offset
tmp$plot_position <- tmp$position
tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig != "wSuz_1"] <-
  tmp$position[tmp$contig != "wSuz_1"] + wSuz_1_length

tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig %in% c("wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")] <-
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig %in% c("wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")] + wSuz_2_length

tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] <-
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] + wSuz_3_length

tapply(tmp$plot_position, tmp$contig, median )

# Plot
plot(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"],
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Genomic position (kb)",
  ylab = "Coverage (per 1 kb window)",
  main = s,
  xlim=c(0, max(tmp$plot_position)/1000),
  ylim=c(0, max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE))
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"],
  type = "l",
  col="red"
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"],
  type = "l",
  col="black"
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"],
  type = "l",
  col="red"
)

# Add a vertical line showing the contig boundary
abline(
  v = c(wSuz_1_length, wSuz_1_length+ wSuz_2_length, wSuz_1_length+ wSuz_2_length+wSuz_3_length) / 1e3,
  lty = 1
)

# Add a vertical line showing the contig boundary
abline(
  v = gene.position$plot_position / 1e3,
  lty = 3
)

text(x=gene.position$label_position[1:3] / 1e3, y= max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE), labels="cif type I")
text(x=gene.position$label_position[4] / 1e3, y= max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE)*0.9, labels="cif type II")

# Labels
axis(
  side = 3,
  at = c(
    wSuz_1_length / 2,
    ( 2 * wSuz_1_length + wSuz_2_length) / 2,
    (2*wSuz_1_length+ 2*wSuz_2_length + wSuz_3_length) / 2,
    (2*wSuz_1_length+ 2*wSuz_2_length + 2*wSuz_3_length + max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"])) /2
  ) / 1e3,
  labels = contig,
  line = 0,
  cex=0.5
)
  
# }
```
